::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 19 [1896?]  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Mrs Dampier](people/person_1345.qmd)

All good thanks and wishes.  Happy you. Poor [Mrs Jones Bateman](people/person_784.qmd).  Lloyd is rejoicing to go. She is gone from home unable to stay alone 

Yours affectionately 
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Dated on the assumption it refers to Rowland Jones Bateman’s death  on 16 December 1896
